correctness.rationale: On each rounding cell the interval endpoints are fixed. Differentiating the finite Poisson mass sum telescopes to p_{ell-1}-p_u; the ratio p_{ell-1}/p_u is a strictly decreasing power of lambda, so any interior stationary point is a strict maximum and no cell contains a minimum. The breakpoint equations are solved exactly. At integer squares, one-sided endpoint changes add a strictly positive atom on either side, proving a strict local minimum. The Poisson CLT gives the square-subsequence limit. These arguments cover every positive parameter; finite checks are supplemental.
